alignment: sample coarse tokens bilinearly at fine patch centers using uncropped resized dimensions and top-left crop, clamping at coarse grid edges
fusion: L2-normalize each aligned scale, concatenate with equal sqrt(0.5) weights, and match one joint reference patch
foreground_mask: the official PCA mask on unmodified 672 final-layer features for both new variants
map_reconstruction: identical official original-resolution renderer with sigma 4
selection: fixed before new test outputs; previous VisA results informed the failure hypothesis; no test-label parameter sweep
